summary: Tested Investigation Portal auth + core flows. Backend: 13/14 pytest cases pass. Login API works, cookies set correctly (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=none), /auth/me returns 200 with cookie. Frontend: After successful login the UI does NOT redirect to /dashboard - user stays stuck on /login. Manually navigating to /dashboard works (proves session is valid). /investigations page crashes with Radix Select runtime error.

minor.issue: Returns mongo '_id' field instead of normalized 'id'. Other endpoints (/api/users, /api/categories) correctly rename _id->id. Inconsistent shape; works because frontend only reads role/email.

Response includes 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' together with 'Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true' (added by Cloudflare/ingress, overrides FastAPI CORSMiddleware). This is invalid per CORS spec and would break true cross-origin requests. Currently works because frontend and backend share the same origin field-ops-44.preview.emergentagent.com (same-origin, no CORS enforcement).

ui_bugs.issue: After successful login (API 200, cookies set, setUser(data) called), the page does NOT navigate to /dashboard. handleSubmit never calls useNavigate. User stays on /login form indefinitely.
Uncaught runtime error: 'A <Select.Item /> must have a value prop that is not an empty string.' Page renders blank/error overlay on /investigations.

integration_issues.issue: Auth flow at API level works (cookies set, /auth/me returns 200, dashboard renders when navigated to). Missing client-side navigation after successful login in Login.js.

action_items: Fix Login.js: import useNavigate from react-router-dom and call navigate('/dashboard') after result.success === true. Optionally also redirect to /dashboard from Login route when user is already authenticated.
Fix /investigations page: find the <SelectItem value=''> (empty string) in the filter/status dropdown and replace empty value with a non-empty sentinel like 'all' (and handle that in filter logic).
Normalize /api/auth/me response: rename _id -> id (or pop _id) similar to /api/users and /api/categories handlers to keep response shape consistent.

(Optional) Replace 'Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *' issue: not a same-origin problem today, but if the app ever serves the frontend from a different host this will break cookie auth in browsers. Consider configuring ingress to echo the request Origin when credentials are used.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 979 lines - should be split into modules (auth, users, categories, investigations, evidence).
get_current_user keeps '_id' on the user dict; /auth/me leaks mongo field name.
Login.js has no post-success navigation; relying solely on state change is fragile because the Login route has no redirect-when-authenticated guard.
Investigation list crashes the whole React tree due to a Select.Item with empty string value - should be caught with an error boundary AND fixed at source.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth API + cookies + /auth/me all confirmed working server-side. Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_auth_and_core.py (13/14 pass; only CORS-wildcard assertion fails, which is enforced by ingress, not FastAPI). Two FE blockers remain: (1) Login.js missing navigate after success, (2) Investigations page Select.Item empty-value crash. After main agent fixes these two, re-run the same playwright login->dashboard->investigations flow.
rca_of_the_issue: Original report claimed '/auth/me returns 401 and cookies not sent'. Reproduction with both curl and Playwright shows cookies ARE set on the browser (access_token, refresh_token, HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=none) and /auth/me returns 200 with user payload. The actual user-visible symptom ('login does nothing') is caused by Login.js not redirecting after success - the user state IS updated but the user remains on /login because no <Navigate> guard exists and handleSubmit never calls useNavigate. Mitigation: add `const navigate = useNavigate();` and `if (result.success) navigate('/dashboard');` in Login.js handleSubmit, plus add a redirect in the /login route when user is already authenticated.
